entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor Smolak, Jorga Azmal and a ha..."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor Smolak, Jorga Azmal and a handful of their ministers joined us around the conference table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A short while later, we reconvened..."
entries.dialogueText: A short while later, we reconvened with Jorga Azmal around the table. This time, we were joined by Wiktor Smolak and his entourage.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Gentlemen. I know it has been hist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gentlemen. I know it has been historically difficult for Wehlen and Derdia to find common ground."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak opened his arms wide."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak opened his arms wide.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I have no idea what you mean, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no idea what you mean, Mr. Esquibel. Derdians are always welcome in my republic."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Or they would be, were it not for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or they would be, were it not for their troublesome associations with the Bludish Freedom Front."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""The same Bludish Freedom Front tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "The same Bludish Freedom Front that your cruel military operation all but eliminated?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We understand the BFF has caused p..."
entries.dialogueText: "We understand the BFF has caused problems for you in the past. But we feel for the innocent Bluds who got caught in the crossfire during your single-minded pursuit of the organization."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""With help from His Majesty, I migh..."
entries.dialogueText: "With help from His Majesty, I might add."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""A pursuit aided by His Majesty, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pursuit aided by His Majesty, I might add."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have you or have you not been harb..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have you or have you not been harboring BFF terrorists within your borders, Azmal?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The BFF are not true Golcondists,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The BFF are not true Golcondists, Supreme Wiseman. They're mere puppets of superpowers who want to destabilize Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, President Smolak, you can't u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, President Smolak, you can't use the BFF as justification for animosity towards Derdia now that they no longer pose a threat."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You cannot wave away the threat th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot wave away the threat that the BFF still poses to Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We give shelter to Golcondists in..."
entries.dialogueText: "We give shelter to Golcondists in need. We keep no record of their pasts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did find Operation Bear Trap rat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did find Operation Bear Trap rather over the top, President Smolak."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""So many Golcondists have died. Am..."
entries.dialogueText: "So many Golcondists have died. Am I wrong in fearing that Derdia will be next?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""As I said at the Alliance of Natio..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said at the Alliance of Nations, there is only one superpower that I believe in. And He has blessed the Bluds on their holly mission."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Nor can we condemn our fellow Golc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nor can we condemn our fellow Golcondists for fighting for their beliefs."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Over the top?! That's all the crit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Over the top?! That's all the criticism the King of Rizia can manage?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Operation Bear Trap raised alarms..."
entries.dialogueText: "Operation Bear Trap raised alarms for us here in Rizia as well."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yet not enough for you to cut ties..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet not enough for you to cut ties with Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento tapped on the table."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento tapped on the table.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The BFF is a volatile topic. Which..."
entries.dialogueText: "The BFF is a volatile topic. Which is precisely why we should not be talking about it."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Let us focus instead on what Derdi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us focus instead on what Derdia and Wehlen can do for each other, and what the Kingdom of Rizia can do for you both."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both men were silent. They nodded w..."
entries.dialogueText: Both men were silent. They nodded warily.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""A longstanding point of contention..."
entries.dialogueText: "A longstanding point of contention has been Derdians gaining passage to Deyr in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's in Deyr again?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's in Deyr again?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why has Wehlen been blocking the D..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why has Wehlen been blocking the Derdians on their holy pilgrimage, President Smolak?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""The Archsanctuay of Deyr is first..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Archsanctuay of Deyr is first and foremost a Dastnurist site, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ah, yes. Our most holy of holy sit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. Our most holy of holy sites."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal and Smolak gave me flabbergas..."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal and Smolak gave me flabbergasted stares.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It is our holiest of holy sites, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is our holiest of holy sites, Your Majesty. Where God delivered His message to Saint Dast."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""The Archsanctuary of Deyr is where..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Archsanctuary of Deyr is where Nurity as a whole came to be. Every true believer must visit it at least once, no matter their denomination."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yet it is said that every true bel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet it is said that every true believer in Nurity must visit it at least once. Wruhecists included."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It sounds like that's a problem fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It sounds like that's a problem for the Sords, not the Rizians."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I wish it were that easy. My frien..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish it were that easy. My friend Anton would solve this in an instant."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Except that Derdians must pass thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Except that Derdians must pass through Wehlen to reach Deyr."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It is the site of God's descension..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is the site of God's descension to Saint Dast. And therefore of particular importance to Dastnurists, not Wruhecists."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Hmm. It's funny how your beloved S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. It's funny how your beloved St. Wruhec didn't come up once in that description."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Your 'friend' couldn't even get th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your 'friend' couldn't even get the Descension Day ceremony right."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""And why should I trust a man who h..."
entries.dialogueText: "And why should I trust a man who harbors the same murderous intentions as you?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""If there was another way to get th..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there was another way to get there, we would use it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Derdians don't have to pass th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Derdians don't have to pass through Wehlen to reach Deyr. We could help them find a sea route."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, I've looked into the possibil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I've looked into the possibility. It would go from Yol through the Sudis Sea all the way around to Lachaven."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Sordland would have to agree to it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland would have to agree to it. But we're on good terms with them right now."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The problem is that Sordland would..."
entries.dialogueText: "The problem is that Sordland would have to agree with it. And we're not on the best of terms right now."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And we can supply the ships oursel..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we can supply the ships ourselves."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The problem is that we don't have..."
entries.dialogueText: "The problem is that we don't have enough ships to spare."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your corridor solution worked with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your corridor solution worked with Morella, Laurento. Can we not do the same thing with Wehlen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's get creative. There must be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's get creative. There must be something that Wehlen would accept in exchange for allowing Derdians through to Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Laurento, your corridor solution m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Laurento, your corridor solution may not have worked with Morella, but could it work with Wehlen?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It might.""
entries.dialogueText: "It might."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""President Smolak, His Majesty is r..."
entries.dialogueText: "President Smolak, His Majesty is referring to the creation of a secure corridor through Wehlen. Derdian pilgrims would be able to pass into Sordland using this route and this route only."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Keeping your Golcondists from frat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keeping your Golcondists from fraternizing with ours. Yes, I like it."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It has yet to be implemented in Mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has yet to be implemented in Morella. But I have high hopes for it."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I did not agree to the idea before..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not agree to the idea before, and I do not understand why it is being proposed again now."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Sounds like a ringing endorsement,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds like a ringing endorsement, Supreme Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Prime Minister Saltana did not agr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana did not agree to the idea. I myself was open to it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What if Rizia oversees the securit..."
entries.dialogueText: "What if Rizia oversees the security of some kind of prayer corridor through Wehlen?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, that's one idea my department..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, that's one idea my department had."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We would plot a route through Wehl..."
entries.dialogueText: "We would plot a route through Wehlen known as 'St. Wruhec's Corridor'. Derdian pilgrims would be able to pass into Sordland using this route and this route only."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Unfortunately, we can't spare the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, we can't spare the military manpower to ensure the security of the route."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We have the military manpower to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have the military manpower to make sure the route is secure."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Rizia would be responsible for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia would be responsible for the route's security."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""So long as your forces were able t..."
entries.dialogueText: "So long as your forces were able to keep Wehlen from blocking our journey, I would agree to this."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Or we can contract an independent..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or we can contract an independent security company."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But we have the budget to contract..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we have the budget to contract an independent security company."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Well... yes, there is.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well... yes, there is."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We want Derdia to buy our oil.""
entries.dialogueText: "We want Derdia to buy our oil."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We are still suffering the effects..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are still suffering the effects of the GRACE embargo on us, among other sanctions."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We have been the subject of unfair..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have been the subject of unfair sanctions. But we have plenty of energy to spare for the right customer."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It is no secret that Derdia needs..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is no secret that Derdia needs energy, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""All the more so since Rizia failed..."
entries.dialogueText: "All the more so since Rizia failed to deliver on its energy promises."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Ha! That's Rizia for you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! That's Rizia for you."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Although not as much as we used to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although not as much as we used to, thanks to our recent deal with Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My kingdom would be very happy to..."
entries.dialogueText: "My kingdom would be very happy to supply the expertise and infrastructure for an oil pipeline between your two nations."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But we cannot afford the infrastru..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we cannot afford the infrastructure that such an agreement would require."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps you could supply Wehlen wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you could supply Wehlen with missiles to raise the needed funds."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""No offense, Your Majesty, but Wehl..."
entries.dialogueText: "No offense, Your Majesty, but Wehlen has no need for Derdian missiles. Have you seen our arsenal?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If Wehlen is so desperate to sell..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Wehlen is so desperate to sell oil, they should pay for the pipeline themselves."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I can agree to fund part of it. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can agree to fund part of it. But not all."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Wehlen will also happily chip in.""
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen will also happily chip in."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Between our two nations, we can de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Between our two nations, we can definitely afford this."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Even then, I am not certain Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even then, I am not certain Rizia can afford it."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We can definitely afford that.""
entries.dialogueText: "We can definitely afford that."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am not certain Rizia can afford..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not certain Rizia can afford it."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Unfortunate. It could've been a pi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunate. It could've been a pivotal step forward in the South Merkopan alliance we are building."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Such a deal could be a pivotal ste..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such a deal could be a pivotal step forward in the South Merkopan alliance we are building."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your Majesty, Rizia should conside..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, Rizia should consider funding this pipeline. If we can afford it, that is."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If we were that desperate, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we were that desperate, Your Majesty, you would have had Zille back five years ago."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Here is my solution.""
entries.dialogueText: "Here is my solution."

entries.dialogueText: Both Azmal and Smolak leaned forward to listen to me.

entries.dialogueText: "We will fund a secure prayer corridor from Derdia through Wehlen to Sordland."

entries.dialogueText: "We will send troops to oversee the security of a Golcondist prayer corridor through Wehlen."
entries.menuText: "We will send troops to oversee the security of a Golcondist prayer corridor through Wehlen." [-250 Manpower]

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will create a sea route for Gol..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will create a sea route for Golcondist pilgrims to reach Sordland without having to cross into Wehlen."
entries.menuText: "We will create a sea route for Golcondist pilgrims to reach Sordland without having to cross into Wehlen." [-1 Ships]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together with Wehlen, we will fund..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together with Wehlen, we will fund an oil pipeline between Wehlen and Derdia. A secure Derdian pilgrimage route will be a condition for this new energy partnership."
entries.menuText: "Together with Wehlen, we will fund an oil pipeline between Wehlen and Derdia. A secure Derdian pilgrimage route will be a condition for this new energy partnership." [-2 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will fund an oil pipeline betwe..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will fund an oil pipeline between Wehlen and Derdia. A secure Derdian pilgrimage route will be a condition for this new energy partnership."
entries.menuText: "We will fund an oil pipeline between Wehlen and Derdia. A secure Derdian pilgrimage route will be a condition for this new energy partnership." [-2 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your nations must practice trust a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your nations must practice trust and cooperation. Remember, we all pray to the same God."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must fight a Derdian Duel of G..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must fight a Derdian Duel of Generosity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor Smolak's eyes lit up with gl..."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor Smolak's eyes lit up with glee. He stood up and started punching the air.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I've always wanted to do one of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've always wanted to do one of these! Will you be your own champion, Supreme Wiseman?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""No! Both of you will stop insultin..."
entries.dialogueText: "No! Both of you will stop insulting myself and my religion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Neither of them looked satisfied."
entries.dialogueText: Neither of them looked satisfied.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""We didn't need to come to Rizia to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We didn't need to come to Rizia to hear that."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""This was a waste of both of our ti..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was a waste of both of our time."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Wehlen accepts, Your Majesty!""
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen accepts, Your Majesty!"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will shake hands.""
entries.dialogueText: "You will shake hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thank the Lord for watching over..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank the Lord for watching over today's talks."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now bring the khisha.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now bring the khisha."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Hrm. That's the best you can do?""
entries.dialogueText: "Hrm. That's the best you can do?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is. Take it or leave it.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is. Take it or leave it."
entries.menuText: "It is. Take it or leave it." [-1 Authority]

entries.dialogueText: "If it helps, Rizia will allocate additional funding towards the project."

entries.menuText: "It is. Take it or leave it." [-2 Authority]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If it helps, Rizia will allocate a..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it helps, Rizia will allocate additional funding towards the project."
entries.menuText: "If it helps, Rizia will allocate additional funding towards the project." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They both shook their heads."
entries.dialogueText: They both shook their heads.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Then our efforts today were in vai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then our efforts today were in vain."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry Rizia could not have be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry Rizia could not have been more helpful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope this will not impact our ef..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope this will not impact our efforts to form the South Merkopan Alliance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was nonetheless a pleasure to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was nonetheless a pleasure to see you both."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you can still assure us a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you can still assure us a safe return of the Zille territory, Mr. Smolak."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Your willingness to help Derdia an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your willingness to help Derdia and Morella shows that your efforts are in good faith."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Two failed mediations in one day?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Two failed mediations in one day? That is truly not a good omen."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Of course, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""A deal with Derdia would have been..."
entries.dialogueText: "A deal with Derdia would have been a mere bonus."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It's not your fault, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's not your fault, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Anytime, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Anytime, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I thank you nonetheless for your h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank you nonetheless for your help with Morella."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Two failed mediations in one day...."
entries.dialogueText: "Two failed mediations in one day. The Lord has not blessed Rizia with the gift of diplomacy."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We will see about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will see about that."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You have both failed the Golcondis..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have both failed the Golcondists. You will be judged poorly for it at the end of your days."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Smolak eagerly reached out his hand..."
entries.dialogueText: Smolak eagerly reached out his hand. Azmal shook it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A Wehzek khisha pipe was standing i..."
entries.dialogueText: A Wehzek khisha pipe was standing in the corner of the room. An aide moved it to our table.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""How thoughtful of Your Majesty! Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "How thoughtful of Your Majesty! But I really must be going."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Praise be to He who unites the uni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Praise be to He who unites the universe."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope this means I can count on b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope this means I can count on both of your countries' cooperation in the formation of a South Merkopan alliance."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Very gladly. Together, we will mak..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very gladly. Together, we will make Rumburg regret its decision to mess with us!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Such modesty. All praise must go t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such modesty. All praise must go to King Romus!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm up to my elbows in paperwork f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm up to my elbows in paperwork for the Zille transition. My citizens have so many concerns. You know how it is."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento swallowed."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento swallowed.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Now. I must be going.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now. I must be going."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I look forward to that day, Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to that day, President Smolak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You had better not be planning any..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had better not be planning any last-minute surprises."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rest assured that Rizia shall make..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured that Rizia shall make the transition as smooth as possible."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Me? Never.""
entries.dialogueText: "Me? Never."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed and left the suite."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed and left the suite.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""There is no doubt in my mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "There is no doubt in my mind."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I am truly grateful for all your h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am truly grateful for all your help today, Your Majesty. Thanks to Rizia, the great Republic of Derdia shall finally be brought out of isolation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I am truly grateful for your help..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am truly grateful for your help today, Your Majesty. I would never have thought Wehlen would be a more cooperative partner than Morella."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Life is full of surprises, Supreme..."
entries.dialogueText: "Life is full of surprises, Supreme Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I am grateful for your help today,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am grateful for your help today, Your Majesty. Thanks to Rizia, the great Republic of Derdia shall finally be brought out of isolation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, we shall take on the wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we shall take on the world."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was my pleasure.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was my pleasure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wiktor is an unusual fellow. But h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wiktor is an unusual fellow. But he holds true to his word."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm up to my elbows in paperwork f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm up to my elbows in paperwork for the Zille transition. My citizens have so many concerns. You know how it is."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I look forward to that day, Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to that day, President Smolak."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You had better not be planning any..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had better not be planning any last-minute surprises."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rest assured that Rizia shall make..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured that Rizia shall make the transition as smooth as possible."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Me? Never.""
entries.dialogueText: "Me? Never."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed as Laurento escorted him o..."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed as Laurento escorted him out of the suite. I sat alone with Azmal for a long minute.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""There is no doubt in my mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "There is no doubt in my mind."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Sorry to cut this party short, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to cut this party short, but I really must be going."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I'm working hard to conclude our a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm working hard to conclude our agreed-upon transfer for Zille. There are a few paperwork challenges left but all is going splendidly."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Unfortunate. But surely there's an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunate. But surely there's another way forward."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Brokering a connection between Weh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brokering a connection between Wehlen and Derdia could be beneficial for everyone involved."
